texts.at-0002: Normalize amounts with round_money before storing Convert any incoming amount with round_money from ledgerly.money before validating or storing it, and compare against ZERO; this also rejects non-finite values like NaN.
texts.at-0003: Guard quantity against bool inputs When validating integer quantities, reject bool explicitly (isinstance(quantity, bool)) before the int check, since True/False pass isinstance(x, int).
